tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: yig med u pa dhe sha'i skor: dam chos sprul sku snying thig las: byur sri dam sri'i mnan pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra padma bdud 'dul gyis: dam chos sprul sku snying thig cha rkyen du: sgrub pa kun gyi sngon 'gro mchog: sgab 'dre byur sri spun dgu yi: mnan pa zab mo 'di bzhin bstan: 'di med sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag kun: sran phung ber rga brgyab dang mtshungs: bdag gzhan gnyis phung thal ba rlung khyer 'dra: de yi phyir na bar gcod byed pa yi: gdon bgegs dam sri byur sri 'di ma mnan na: rmi lam du yang rang gi zas nor gzhan la ster ba dang: gzhan gyis hab khyer du khyer ba dang: ci byed thams cad lam du mi 'gro zhing: tha na za kha 'thung kha tshun: pho gtor 'os med du red pa dang: rmi lam gyi ltas log cing: mi nor zas gsum la bar du gcod pa mang ba dang: mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan ci byung yang: 'di nyid la 'bungs shing zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs: phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang sgrub kyang 'di la 'bad par gces so: 'di ni bdag 'dra padma bdud 'dul gyis: rdzas zlog log tri nag po'i rgyud nas btus: mnan pa 'di nyid lan gcig byas gyur na: gdon bgegs kyi nus pa 'joms par 'gyur: lan gnyis bskyar na bgegs rigs thams cad nye mi nus: lan gsum bskyar na gdon bgegs rnams la smros ci dgos: srid gsum lha 'dre kun gyi srog 'phrog nas: bskal pa brgyar yang gnod mi nus: 'di nyid ma mnan dam chos bsgrub pa ni: gang zag kun gyis 'dod pa'i don rnams mi 'grub cing: tshe thung nad mang rta nor god brlag mang: srid dang sris rnams mi smin cing: ma nyes kha yog dgra gyod rkyen ngan mang: yid mi dga' zhing thams cad 'khrug: zhing la lo thog mi skye bzhon mi zos: las kyi phugs rnams thams cad 'di yis gtor bar byed: de rnams gdams pa 'di nyid ma ldan zhing: bgegs rnams ma non gnad yin pas: gdams pa 'di bzhin nyams len shin tu gces: ci phyir gdams pa dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni:

dam sri bsnyab pa lag ring bon por brdzus nas ni: chos byed sgrub pa kun la bar chad byed: dam sri yam shud dmar po khyi ru brdzus nas ni: rta nor nor phyugs kun la bar chad byed: the'u rang stong sde nag po ni: dmag dang zang zing rnams kyi bla: ban btsun rnams su sprul nas ni: bu smad rnams la bar chad byed: dam sri bse mo bud med rigs ngan rnams su sprul nas ni: rang gi bu mo chung ma rnams la bar chad byed: 'gong nag thams cad sngags bon dge bshes rnams su sprul: 'khor slob thams cad sems dkrug cing: ci byas thams cad legs su mi ster ro: de'i phyir na gdams ngag 'di la 'bad pa gces: gdams ngag 'di ldan bsgrub pa'i skal ldan kun: tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor dbang thang rgyas: mnga' thang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa dang: ci byas thams cad las su rung ba dang: bsam pa'i don rnams 'bad med 'grub pa 'byung: de nas bca' gzhi'i rim pa ni: nyi shu dgu yi nyi ma dmar thag chad pa'i tshe: 'dre 'tshubs sa dang dug sna tshogs tshad kun: snag tshar bsres la bgegs kyi rū pa dang: dug shog che la khog yangs pa: dbus su mi mgo de steng bya yi mgo: g.yas su rta mgo g.yon du spre'u mgo can: yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa: tshigs bzhi la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: snying gar tri dzaḥdagu yi mthar: yig mgo nang bstan 'di nyid bkod: byur sri dam sri bsnyab pa lag ring thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: byur sri dam sri yam shud dmar po thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: byur sri dam sri the'u rang stong sde thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: byur sri dam sri bse mo spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: rag mo spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: yag mo spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: shwa na ma spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: gson 'dre mo thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan:

bse rag spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: chung 'dre chung sri thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: phung 'dre phung sri thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: mkhon 'dre mkhon sri thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: dam sri 'gong po spun dgu thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: gnod byed dam sri phung 'dre phung sri byur 'dre byur sri gyod 'dre gyod sri god 'dre god sri nad 'dre gdon bgegs glags 'gong thams cad tri dza mā ra ya rbad nan nan: mgo bo bzhi la: oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ suṃ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: de nas spyi bo nas sngags mgo phyir bstan la bri'o: oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭān ta ka da ha pa tsa hūm̐ gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badzra log tri pā la nan: sa ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ nan: tsi tsa ra tsi tsa ra: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad kra ko sha ya: rbad kra ko sha ya: ho ra ho ra: gnod byed tsi du sod: tsi du sod: lus shigs lhu ru gtubs: ha la pa tri rbad nan: 'khor ba thul: kā ya wā ka tsitta rlag rlag: gnod byed 'byung po pho mo mā ra ya rbad nan: long ka long ka: du ra du ra: hab sha hab sha: gnod byed byur sri dam sri chung sri god sri dar sri 'byung po pho mo skyugs shig skyugs shig: kha thaṃ: kha thaṃ: mchu chings: mchu chings: gre bsdam gre bsdam: bhan dha bhan dha: mu dha ye rbad nan nan: haṃ shaṃ tri ru tri bhi he sha rbad nan nan: tri'u tri'u: tri kha sha: tri'u dza ra tri ye rbad nan nan: du tri tri rbad rbad nan nan: shi tri ni rbad nan nan: ka tri ni rbad nan nan: tri du chung sri ni rbad nan nan: du tri god 'dre mo rbad nan nan: gruṃ gruṃ dam sri byur sri chung sri god sri dar sri sgab 'dre nyes byed pho mo thams cad kyi srog la tri mā ra ya rbad nan nan: 'byung po dam sri pho mo a mu kaṃ snying du nan nan:

tri du nan nan: dza tri nan nan: snying gzer bur nan nan: gnod byed sarba kā ya wā ka tsitta nan nan: gnod byed dam sri pho mo'i lus ngag yid gsum pa tha hūm̐ laṃ suṃ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan: bhi steng st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: tri dza tri hrī: ma da ya su tri ya du tri ya ma tri ya da tri dza he: da ra ni dza: dam sri byur sri chung sri god sri 'byung po pho mo thams cad kha thaṃ: lus chings ngag chings yid kyi dran pa rmugs par gyis shig: chings chings nan nan: paksha paksha: raksha raksha: thuṃ thuṃ: gnod byed pho mo reng reng: ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: gnod byed pho mo mā ra ya nan: 'khums shig 'khums shig: khrag tu skyugs shig nan nan: tshin dha tshin dha nan nan: bhin dha bhin dha gnod byed pho mo nan nan: chings chings dam sri pho mo nan nan chings chings: byur sri pho mo nan nan chings chings: che sri pho mo nan nan chings chings: chung sri pho mo nan nan chings chings: god 'dre god sri pho mo nan nan chings chings: za 'dre phung sri thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan nan chings chings: phugs kyi sris la za ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: khyim gyi bu la za ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: sgo yi nor la za ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: legs su mi ster ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: nyes su dga' ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: skabs blta zhing glags tshol ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: chag che zhing nyam nga ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: mo ltas pra rtags ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: 'di bri ba dang thun skabs su 'don pa gnyis ka bya'o: hūm̐ bhyo: dam sri bya ba'i sdig chen khyod: chu srin nag po'i kha ru bstabs: gri thog stong gis bskor ba yis: thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan: gser gyi ri bdun bskor nas bzhag:

khyed rnams rnam smin las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du bskyur: rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor nas bzhag: khyed rnams thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: gnam lcags 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon: mtshon cha'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhag: khyed rnams thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: khro rgyal khrag 'thung rnams kyi zhal du bstabs: nag po stong gis bskor ba yi: khyed rnams thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: sreg byed me yi dkyil du bsregs: me phung 'bar bas bskor ba yi: khyed rnams thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: bskal pa 'jig kyang thar mi 'gyur: chu srin nag po'i hom khung du: rin chen nor bu tshud pa ltar: mtha' yi rgya mtsho bskams kyang mi gtang ngo: nyi zla thang du lhung yang mi gtang ngo: bskal pa 'jig kyang mi gtang ngo: ri rab chen po nyil yang mi gtang ngo: rnal 'byor bsam pa ma 'grub bar: khyed rnams thar med las kyi btson rar tshud: mnar med btson khang nag po'i gnas su tshud: gnod byed byur sri dam sri che 'dre chung 'dre god 'dre god sri pho mo thams cad kha thaṃ mchu chings shig: tri du tri mā ra ya rbad nan: oṃ laṃ suṃ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: ༈ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭān ta ka da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ya mānta ka ya ma rā tsa gnod byed byur sri mi la spun dgu dam sri za 'dre phung sri che 'dre chung sri: god 'dre god sri sgab 'dre sgab sri pho mo sarba dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥm hā de wa tri mā ra ya rbad nan: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya e dza tri nṛ dza rbad dza khug dza aṃ ku sha dza dza: oṃ ma hā dhe wa hūm̐: u ma dhe wī hrī: mi la ku ru bse rag shan tri god 'dre tsitta bse mo ru tri ka la sha tri sarba gnod byed nan nan:

gnod byed bdud bsnyab pa lag ring ru tri dza: ru tri hur thuṃ dza tri mā ra ya dza: st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: gnod byed btsan yam shud dmar po ru tri dza ru tri hur thuṃ dza: tri mā ra ya dza: st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: gnod byed the'u rang stong 'khrug ru tri dza: ru tri hur thuṃ dza: tri mā ra ya dza: bdud btsan the'u rang stong 'khrug st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: chings shig chings shig swā hā: badzra ra tri tri mā ra ya nṛ tri kro mā ra ya sod: yaksha mā ra ya du tri dza: gza' bdud chen po'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i gnod byed pho mo rnams khug cig: sarba gnod byed kā ya wā ka tsitta nan chings shig: sarba raksha st+waṃ bha ya nan nan: de'i phyi rim dza khraṃ dang rdo rje'i zhags khug gis bskor ro: de nas rū pa dug sna tshogs dang thun rdzas mi kha'i rdzas rnams kyi du bas bdug la: ro g.yam nag po'i steng du bzhag la: rang nyid rdo rje gro lod kyi sa mā ti dang ldan pa'i ngang nas: dzaḥdamar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: gnod byed pho mo'i tri nas bzung zhing rang dbang med par rū pa la bstim: rdzas ni la phug: khog ma'i drag pa: thun rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs: rbab rdo: mkhar sgong: 'dre can gnas pa'i lung gsum 'dus pa'i mdo'i rdo rnams khrag sna tshogs tshad kyis sbrus la: sngags kyi mthar: hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: sogs brjod cing brab: de nas rū pa sha lpags ltar dril la tshon skud sna lngas bcing: rab spyang thod dam gcan gzan thod pa: 'bring wa thod: tha ma yang khyi thod kyi nang du bcug la hom khung du bcug nas: zhag bdun nam gsum mam nyer gcig sogs gang rung bsgrub bo: de tshe rtags kyi rim pa ni: khyi spyang bud med byi la spre'u rnams gsod pa dang: bud med mang po ngu ba dang: ban btsun sngags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba sogs rtags rnams bzang ngan sna tshogs 'ong:

de nas klad khung du mi kha'i rdzas dang thun rdzas sna tshogs blugs: thod pa ya mgal la pho shing stag pa dang ma mgal mo shing glang ma: dug tsher skyer pa gcig skyes rnams kyi phur pa mang po btsugs: khyi spu ra bal gyis thod pa rgya gram du bcing: sgro chen sor bzhi yar bcad pa'i sgros bsgron pa'i mda' mde'u can dang: 'phang mthil dang mi kha'i rdzas sna tshogs blugs: nam gyi srod la rang gi them 'og tu mnan: mda' phur rnams thod par btsugs shing phyi ro ras kyis bstum: mtshul pa sa la gtugs: ri rab dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan: de'i steng du sa: de'i steng du me bzhag la: chus gsad: 'gugs 'dren bya: rta bro brdung: 'di brtson skal ldan gang zag kun: phrin las gang brtsam 'bad med myur du 'grub: tshe ring nad med mnga' thang snyan grags rgyas: lo legs sris sme nor phyugs 'phel ba dang: sris sme longs spyod kun ldan 'gyur: rtag tu byang chub bsgrub pa dang: tha na mi nag skye bos yin yang rung: gdams ngag 'di la brtson par gces: skal ldan snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: badzra sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: rgyal dbang padma 'byung gnas thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i/ rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul rdo rjes tsha ba sgro brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/// /
